Staff Vacancy
Thursday, 13 May 2021
5607 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data, certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates for the following temporary posts. The applications must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha – 442102, Maharashtra latest by
27
th
May 2021
.
Radiotherapy Technician-2 (1SC & 1 VJNT)
Qualification & Experience
: The candidate must have B.Sc degree in Radiotherapy Technology (3 years course) from a recognized Institute/University approved by AERB along with 2 years experience in an established radiotherapy center equipped with linear accelerator and brachytherapy techniques.
OR
Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology (2 years course) from a recognized Institute/University approved by AERB with 3 years’ experience in an established radiotherapy center equipped with linear accelerator and brachytherapy techniques.
Medical Physicist cum RSO-1 (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
The candidate must have M.Sc. in Medical Physics from a recognized Institute/University and minimum 12 months of internship in a recognized well ‐equipped radiation therapy department
OR
MSc in Physics with Diploma in Radiological/Medical physics from BARC or from AERB recognized university/institution and minimum 12 months of internship in a recognized well‐equipped radiation therapy department. 2 years’ experience in the Radiotherapy Department in a Medical College. He/ She should also have a Radiological Safety Officer (RSO) certificate.
Salary:
As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age:
Upper age limit 38 years for open category and 43 years for reserved category.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
